title: 課程管理 API (後端) — GET + POST + PATCH + DELETE
acceptance: GET /api/courses?locale=en&category=cpd — returns paginated, filtered course list with schedules
GET /api/courses/[slug]?locale=en — returns single course with instructors, syllabus, schedules, reviews, FAQs
POST /api/courses — admin creates course (all ZH/EN fields, nested create for syllabus/schedules/FAQs)
verification: GET /api/courses → returns array. GET /api/courses/cpd-101 → returns full course with relations. POST with admin token → creates. POST without → 403.
